Spatiotemporal Bilateral Gradient Filtering for Inverse Rendering
The same idea also has been applied to inverse rendering recently [Nicolet et al. 2021]. These works use the inverse Laplacian operator as the spatial filter, which can lead to slow convergence at sharp regions of the recovered signal.
